_doc: Replay set for evals/review-replay.sh (08-review.md AC10, 10-rollout-eval.md §5 'Recall review'). Each task: the ewallet repo, the diff range the v0.11 auditors reviewed (base..head, from the review.md scope line or the task's commits), the v0.11 dispatch count read from review.md, and every MED+ finding of that review.md with its reporter and defect class; locus is only what review.md cites (null when it cites none). class → lane: security→security · db|perf→db · contract|observability→contract · correctness|conventions|comments|duplication|dead-code|test-quality→reviewer (the reviewer floor). scope=out-of-diff marks a pre-existing finding outside the diff (reported apart, not in the diff-scope recall). v011_tier is the tier the v0.11 run used (route: small|trivial|main-thread → light, full → full). historical.source names the review-cost.sh wave (session + start) when the task falls in the transcript window, else the review.md line. Selection method and strata: header of evals/review-replay.sh. `file` (2026-10-01, file-level recall): the changed file a finding lives in, set by hand from review.md where `locus` is null or names a cited file outside the diff; review-replay.sh matches `file`, else `locus`, against the diff's files and the selector's `partial[].uncovered`.
